sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Berrey Dhone is a Manx goddess. Her name means Brown Berry. She was a hag or witch on the Isle of Man. She lived on top of North Barrule Mountain or inside it. Like other forms of the Cailleach, she was a giant. Her rocky heelprint can still be seen on the mountainside.

okr.objective: Berrey Dhone is a Manx goddess whose mountain home and giant footprint mark the Isle of Man.
